market_education.summary_en: Today the two main indexes moved in different directions: the NASDAQ gained 0.4% while the S&P 500 dipped 0.2%. That usually means investors favored growth and technology names, especially cybersecurity and software, where several screened stocks (RBRK, TENB, CRWD, PANW) show strong momentum, while more defensive or cyclical parts of the broader index lagged. No specific news headlines were provided for today's session, so this explanation is based only on the index moves and sector momentum in our screening data.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日兩大指數走勢分歧，納斯達克指數上升0.4%，標普500指數則微跌0.2%。資金明顯偏好增長型及科技股，尤其是網絡安全及軟件板塊，RBRK、TENB、CRWD、PANW等多隻股票動能強勁，而大市中較防守性或周期性的板塊則表現落後。由於今日未有提供具體新聞標題，以上分析僅根據指數表現及篩選數據中的板塊動能作出。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Index divergence is when major stock indexes move in opposite directions on the same day, like today when the NASDAQ rose and the S&P 500 fell. It usually means money is moving between sectors, here toward tech and away from the rest of the market, rather than the whole market rising or falling together. Investors often treat divergence as a 'neutral' signal and are more careful about adding new positions until both indexes agree.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 指數背馳是指主要股市指數在同一日朝相反方向走，例如今日納斯達克上升而標普500下跌。這通常代表資金在板塊之間轉移，今次是流向科技股、離開其他板塊，而不是整個大市同步升跌。投資者一般將指數背馳視為「中性」訊號，在兩大指數方向一致之前，加倉會較為審慎。
